title: Dot-matrix field: grey dots of four sizes forming faint soft shapes around a clear disc with a mascot slot in the middle
use: The closing band of a page or a footer backdrop. seed changes the shapes (same seed, same field), density how much of the grid is filled. The mascot slot is yours.

density.note: how much of the dot grid is filled

mascot.note: the mascot (144 x 144, transparent); your own art

relations: 24-unit dot grid, four dot radii (1.2-3.75 units); the two larger classes are lighter grey.
A clear disc of 118 units around the canvas centre holds the mascot slot; the bottom corners stay clear for the label and the hint.
decoration: The whole dot field: drawn, deterministic for a seed.

provenance.corpus: benchlog case: our own original developer blog in the devlog-terminal grammar (post index, article with rail and header, figure frame, closing dot field), original copy and our own pixel glyphs
provenance.experiment: styles/devlog-terminal/style.json provenance (a public developer blog the owner named, read and measured privately in Chrome; never shipped)
provenance.method: The closing dot-matrix field of the blog re-built from soft blobs at 1440 x 480.
measured: Reference: grey dots of varying size forming faint shapes with a mascot in the middle; here the shapes are seeded blobs.
